high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article titled "Indian Navy Eyes Arabian Sea and Andamans with New Drishti-10 Drones." The article was published on February 11, 2024, by the admin of IDRW.ORG. The source of the article is attributed to the IDRW.ORG team. The main focus of the image is a photograph of a military drone in flight against a backdrop of a clear blue sky with some scattered clouds. The drone appears to be a long-winged aircraft with a streamlined body, equipped with what looks like a camera or sensor pod mounted at the front.
